offlineBody: Munim can't reach the server. What you see may be out of date, and new questions, credit and offers are paused until you're back online.
langBusy: Wait for the answer before changing language
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errorOffline: Can't reach Munim. Check your internet connection and try again.
salesDefinition: Total of successful payments received. This is sales, not profit.
compareDown: {amount} ({pct}%) below a usual {weekday}. The 4-week {weekday} average is {baseline}.
compareUp: {amount} ({pct}%) above a usual {weekday}. The 4-week {weekday} average is {baseline}.
compareFlat: About the same as a usual {weekday}. The 4-week {weekday} average is {baseline}.
repeatShareLine: Regular customers (5+ visits) made {pct}% of sales over the last 90 days.
chimeNote: Starts with the Soundbox chime (simulated), then Munim reads the briefing.
briefingNoAudio: Audio isn't available for this briefing right now. You can read it below.
audioFailedBody: You can still read the text.
cashWhy: At the lowest point the balance may be about {shortfall} below zero. Main reason: {label}, {amount} due on {due}.
cashWhyNoDriver: At the lowest point the balance may be about {shortfall} below zero.
creditAvailable: A pre-approved credit offer of {amount} is available. The decision is yours.
noGap: Cash looks fine for the next 14 days.
growthInsightBody: regular customers haven't visited in 14 days or more. Munim has drafted an offer for you to review.
askSub: Speak or type in your language. Answers come from your own shop data.
askHint: Tap the mic and speak, or type your question.
askOffline: You're offline. New questions are paused.
micDenied: Type your question instead, or allow the microphone in your browser settings.
micEmpty: Didn't hear anything. Tap the mic and try again, or type.
micUnsupported: Voice isn't supported in this browser. Type your question instead.
noAudio: No voice reply for this answer. Read it above.
evidenceNone: No database query was used for this answer.
evidenceEmpty: The query found no matching rows.
evidenceOne: Based on {n} row from your data.
evidenceMany: Based on {n} rows from your data.
evidenceEmptyBody: The query ran but returned no rows, so there is no data to show.
cashSub: Your next 14 days. Forecast as of {date}.
cashShortEvenWithCredit: Even with the credit, cash may run short on {date}
cashOkWithCredit: With the credit, cash stays above zero for the next 14 days.
forecastNotGuarantee: This is a forecast, not a guarantee.
scenarioHypotheticalNote: This is a what-if. You haven't accepted any credit.
noForecastBody: There isn't enough data to forecast cash right now.
assumeSales: Expected sales: the average of the same weekday over the last 8 weeks.
assumeCosts: Running costs: your usual share of sales.
assumePayments: Known payments are taken off on the day they are due.
assumeCredit: If credit is added, it is counted on the first forecast day.
staleForecastTitle: This forecast may be out of date
staleForecastBody: It was last updated at {time}. Reconnect to see the current forecast.
staleForecastNoTime: Munim couldn't refresh it. Reconnect to see the current forecast.
noObligations: No payments are due in the next 14 days.
noOffer: There's no credit offer right now.
creditWhy: You're seeing this because cash is forecast to go below zero on {date}.
creditEffect: If you accept, the forecast keeps cash above zero. The lowest balance would be {amount} on {date}.
decisionIsYours: The decision is yours. Munim won't accept credit unless you confirm.
actionOffline: You're offline, or the data couldn't refresh. This action is paused until you're back online.
creditSimNote: Demo action: the credit is marked approved here, but no money was disbursed.
creditConfirmIntro: Check the details below. Nothing happens until you confirm.
creditDeclineIntro: You can't undo this in the demo.
demoActionNote: Demo: this action is simulated. No money moves and no customer is contacted.
voiceUndecided: Couldn't tell yes from no. Try again or use the button.
sayYesNo: Say “yes” to go ahead or “no” to decline. Voice only applies to the action shown here.
growSub: Bring regular customers back, with your approval.
ruleText: Regular = 5 or more visits. Lapsed = no visit in the last 14 days.
avgSpendLine: They spend about {amount} a month on average (estimate).
privacyNote: Munim shows only counts here, not customer names or numbers.
noCampaignNone: No regular customers are overdue right now.
noCampaignBody: Munim hasn't drafted an offer yet.
goalValue: Bring lapsed regular customers back to your shop
expectedActionValue: Customers see the offer and visit your shop within {days} days.
editNote: Only this wording is used when you approve.
campaignConfirmIntro: This is exactly what will go out. Check the message and who gets it.
campaignSimNote: Demo action: no message was actually sent to any customer.
simulatedHint: Nothing real was sent or paid
loginSub: Your voice-first business partner: daily briefing, cash forecast and customer offers, in your language.
phoneHelp: We'll send a one-time code to this number.
demoCodeNote: Shown because demo mode is on. Real accounts get a code by SMS.
demoMerchantsNote: Synthetic data. One tap signs in with a demo code. This is not real authentication.
legendCreditApproved: Forecast with the credit you accepted (simulated)
